guide: Enter a number or letter, then Enter. M: main; 0: back.
Trade: 2 market, 3 buy, quantity, Y confirm. Sell with 4 at another planet.
Travel: 6 normal travel costs 0 Cr. 7 warp selects a speed; review cost and ETA.
8 invests in industry; 9 donates to routes. The engine determines effects.
S: ships. I: insurance. Bankruptcy is under 1 status, B, with confirmation.
R: rankings; H: hall. Shared worlds share markets with other BBS sites.
In flight: N news, W online, M map refresh. Trade after arrival.
Lists: N next, P previous. Confirmation: Y confirm, N cancel. Enter never confirms.
Offline updates stop. Reconnect, then result checks uncertain requests.
Legacy commands remain available at main, e.g. buy grain 5.
